correctness.rationale: Radial-order graph model Γ_{m,k} has A-vertices equal to m ordered arm words, B-vertices equal to one center label plus words, and m edges from each B. Counts k! binom(k+m-1,m-1), k! binom(k+m-2,m-1), and m times the latter give known Betti rank E-V+1. Simultaneous symmetry fixes an A-word iff every d-cycle of particle labels is placed, with one of d phases, on an arm d-cycle, yielding F(α,β)=∏ d^{c_d}c_d! binom(c_d+a_d-1,a_d-1). Fixed B-vertices require a fixed center particle, count B; fixed edges are a_1 B. Lefschetz then yields 1-F+(a_1-1)B. Taking orbit arm occupancies gives A-partitions of k, B-partitions of k-1, and distinct Young-cover edge orbits, producing rank r_m(k). A six-vertex cycle exists for k≥5, with m≥3; direct partition enumeration gives tree for k≤4 and r_m(5)=1. Independently reconstructed 360 A, 240 B and 720 edges at (m,k)=(3,4), checked all 144 S_3×S_4 character values by actual fixed-word enumeration, and checked quotient partition ranks for k=2..8. The equivariant collar/graph-model equivalence uses the stated convex radial-order strata and central transfers; the finite check corroborates but does not replace that topology.
